title: BUGFIX — Allow production-mode videos through QC when clips are synthesised from discovery
rationale: agents/scs001-qc/index.ts checkHasRealClip() fails all videos with clip_source='production' or 'mock' in live mode. For the sprint-1408 synthesised-clips path, EditingAgent intentionally uses production mode (colored title cards) since no real video files exist. The QC gate was designed to prevent accidental mock-mode renders from being published, not to block an intentional fallback path. Without this fix, 0 videos pass QC in the synthesised-clips path. Fix: add opts.allowProductionClip parameter to QCAgent.run(); pass clipsAreSynthesized from orchestrator Stage 8.

tasks.description: Two-file fix: (1) agents/scs001-qc/index.ts: change checkHasRealClip signature to checkHasRealClip(edited, allowProductionClip: boolean). Add condition: if (allowProductionClip) return pass. Change QCAgent.run() signature to accept optional opts?: { allowProductionClip?: boolean }. Pass allowProductionClip to checkHasRealClip in review(). (2) agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts Stage 8: change agent.run(captionedVideos, bundles, editedVideos) to agent.run(captionedVideos, bundles, editedVideos, { allowProductionClip: clipsAreSynthesized }).
